honesty.fabrication_policy: Report only what the data shows. A dry or blocked source is declared in source_status — never filled in with plausible fiction.
limitations: Moltbook sample is the public feed snapshot at run time, not the whole network.
GitHub unauthenticated search caps at 10 req/min; only 3 queries per run.
Sentiment is a heuristic word list, not a model — treat as a vibe check.
No source exposes agent geography; regional notes are language/script proxies.
Trend 'shifts' need consecutive runs; the first run only sets baselines.
